# BootstrapRequest

`schemas/api/bootstrap-request.json`

The body of POST /v1/bootstrap (docs/design/m0/04 "Bootstrap", 14 R4), served only on the private socket and without a bearer: the one-time setup secret from &lt;state_dir&gt;/bootstrap.secret creates the first operator and its first token. The writer runs it once per idempotency_key; a repeat with the same body replays the stored result without the token.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idempotency_key` | yes | string (pattern `^[\x21-\x7e]+$`, maxLength `200`) |  |
| `secret` | yes | string (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{42}[AEIMQUYcgkosw048]$`) | The setup secret: 32 bytes of base64url, never logged or stored. |
| `name` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `200`) | The first operator's display name. |

No other fields are allowed.
